name: ColorStop
description: Represents the color stop point for a gradient fill in a range or selection.
remarks: The ColorStop object enables you to set properties for the cell fill, including the Color, ThemeColor, and TintAndShade properties.
example:
With Selection.Interior
 .Pattern = xlPatternLinearGradient
 .Gradient.Degree = 135
 .Gradient.ColorStops.Clear
End With

With Selection.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0)
 .ThemeColor = xlThemeColorDark1
 .TintAndShade = 0
End With

With Selection.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(0.5)
 .ThemeColor = xlThemeColorAccent1
 .TintAndShade = 0
End With

With Selection.Interior.Gradient.ColorStops.Add(1)
 .ThemeColor = xlThemeColorDark1
 .TintAndShade = 0
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the represented object. Read/write.

properties.name: ThemeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the theme color of the represented object. Read/write.

properties.name: TintAndShade
properties.description: Returns or sets the tint and shade of the represented object. Read/write

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of the ColorStop. Read/write.
